claim: C1 (primary): fresh per-sample plan noise (PN) is the cheapest knob for CORRECT algorithmic diversity
statistic: correct-only Hill-1, rarefied at depth 25; vertices: Step-0 rarefied_hill1 (hypergeometric, n_sub 1000, rng default_rng(0)) for knob rows; hull points: population rarefaction (mean exp(Shannon) of multinomial(25, q), fixed uniform matrix U[n_sub, 25], n_sub 1000 point / 200 bootstrap)
correct: passed all hidden tests within limits and label != 'invalid'

price.H5: max Hill on the class's randomisation hull at cost <= 5 pass points
price.P15: smallest c >= 0 with max Hill at cost <= c >= 1.5 (bisection/grid to 0.1 points)

hull: mixtures over {reference} u settings; search on every pairwise edge, lambda grid 0.025, exact cost-5 boundary points, golden-section refinement on the best edge (point estimates); full-simplex check reported (3-vertex faces)

classes.reference: TWIN for this artifact's arms; the reused vetoes' own twin (exp13 'twin' vLLM; exp16 'b' on T2); PLAIN for PNPLAIN; T1 vetoes have no iteration-3 twin -> this artifact's TWIN (flagged)

bootstrap.scheme: programs resampled with replacement within each arm, stratified by template; every vertex, class H5/P15/P20 and the max over settings and over NA classes recomputed INSIDE each replicate

decision.task_bootstrap: 2,000 two-stage replicates: resample the 6 tasks with replacement, each drawn task takes an independent program-bootstrap replicate; 95% percentile CI; p_C1 = (1 + #{D_bar* <= 0}) / 2001 (for the cross-artifact Holm family)
decision.undecidable: a never-drop cell missing on an E6 task -> UNDECIDABLE on that task; the rule is evaluated on the remaining tasks as a labelled sensitivity

other_mapping: correct 'other' programs are audited: LABELLER MISS -> resolved catalogue label; CATALOGUE VARIANT -> parent catalogue mode (or its own named-variant category if outside the catalogue); DEGENERATE -> excluded from Hill counts, still passed; NOVEL -> own category per algorithm. Sensitivities: 'other' excluded; 'other' as one category

sensitivities.s2: MINP (T1.6, T2.0 at min-p 0.1) and VS added to NA

descriptive: PLAIN vs TWIN and PNPLAIN_a1 vs PN_a1
precision: FP8 W8A8 (device table: 16 GB Ada); the engine check verdict is carried into every C1 statement
max_new: 1024 tokens for every task (the screen's cap; plan's 1,536 for path tasks not used, deviation D-cap)
